$comment: Built-in kit 'superpowers': enables obra/superpowers 7.0.2 (MIT, pinned in sandbox-ai's marketplace). Install with: sandbox-ai plugins claude --kit superpowers; approve its SessionStart hook with: sandbox-ai kits trust-hooks superpowers; use with: sandbox-ai claude --kit superpowers. Claude only: Codex plugins are not supported yet, its OpenCode plugin is installed from Git at run time.
